subject.title: [Feature]: Add model parameter prompts (context window, max_tokens, modalities) during OpenAI-compatible provider onboarding CLI flow

question: Should OpenClaw accept an interactive custom-provider model metadata editor, and should it live in onboard, configure, or a unified setup path?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but adding prompts or flags changes public setup behavior and persisted provider model metadata semantics, so maintainers need to choose the UX and compatibility contract before automation opens another fix.

options.title: Accept a preserved-metadata editor
options.body: Land or replace the broader prompt work after it preserves all supported modalities, API overrides, pricing, and existing metadata on reconfiguration.

options.title: Design one unified setup surface
options.body: Pause the implementation PRs until maintainers define how onboard, configure, non-interactive setup, and dynamic discovery should share model metadata configuration.

options.title: Keep only narrower fixes
options.body: Defer broad prompts and handle urgent context-window gaps through narrower defaults, doctor guidance, or explicit non-interactive options.

recommendation.title: Accept a preserved-metadata editor
recommendation.body: Land or replace the broader prompt work after it preserves all supported modalities, API overrides, pricing, and existing metadata on reconfiguration.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent history on the custom-provider context-limit repair and provider/config compatibility surface.
